Maya (Docs): quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today
Maya (Docs): did final pass on SDK quickstart for python, added small note about env var order. pushed branch and opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482
Alex (DevEx): nice, grabbing it for review in a bit :eyes:
Maya (Docs): blocker: sampleapp iOS embed fails on first run for newer Xcode — stacktrace attached in PR, guessing it's a path issue with the local model loader
Drew: I can take a look at the sampleapp later today, have a local mac env ready. did you try setting RW_MODEL_PATH? sometimes upstream CI uses relative path and iOS chokes
Maya (Docs): yep tried RW_MODEL_PATH, still tripped on a file permission error in the script that extracts the bundle 
Samir: fyi the CI flake on linux sampleapp was fixed in canary yesterday, might be unrelated but pinged infra to ensure parity on mac runners
Maya (Docs): thanks — for docs tasks today: merge python quickstart after Alex review, add patch note to migration guide, and file a tiny troubleshooting doc for the iOS sampleapp error
Alex (DevEx): reviewing now. small nit: in the example code we still reference client.token — new SDK uses Client(apiKey=...). I'll comment inline.
Maya (Docs): ah good catch, missed that ref when we updated the SDK. will update once you post comments.
ci-bot: build #7852 passed for branch fix/quickstart-py + docs lint OK :white_check_mark:
Alex (DevEx): left two comments and one suggested code change (see PR). also ran the sample quickstart locally, worked after swapping to Client(apiKey=...)
Maya (Docs): addressing now. pushing a follow-up commit with the code change and an extra note about the env var precedence.
Drew: for the iOS sampleapp, I'll try reproducing with Xcode 15 and 15.1, will report back here with minimal repro steps.
Samir: small heads-up: we're planning a micro deploy of the new sample assets today at 6pm PT — if anyone's relying on sampleapp artifact names, they should avoid tagging new releases until after deploy
Maya (Docs): thanks, noted — will coordinate on PR merge timing so the sampleapp doc links stay stable
Alex (DevEx): quick question — do we want the python quickstart to show streaming or not? current draft shows a single .generate() call.
Maya (Docs): prefer streaming in the quickstart for engagement, but keep the non-streaming example in an appendix. I'll add a short streaming snippet:```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(apiKey="$REDWOOD_API_KEY")
for chunk in client.generate_stream("Write a haiku about latency"):
    print(chunk.text, end='')
```
Alex (DevEx): perfect. once you push the fix i'll approve and merge.
Maya (Docs): will push in ~15m after i run the sampleapp repro on Drew's notes. ping me if anything else breaks. :shipit:
Drew: ack, I'll drop mac repro notes here when ready.
Samir: thanks team — no blockers from infra side.
Maya (Docs): end of standup.
